name: Dear ImGui
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Native C++ immediate-mode debug UI; no agent-drivable route
summary: Immediate-mode C++ GUI library for tool panels and debug overlays inside native apps (OpenGL, Metal, Vulkan backends). It is a compile-time dependency of a C++ host, not a tool: there is no CLI, scripting API or output. Relevant only when building a native renderer that needs live parameter sliders.
use_when: Building a custom native C++ renderer that needs live parameter sliders
avoid_when: Browser scenes: Leva or Theatre.js expose parameters without C++
Any scripted render pipeline: no headless route, use Playwright capture
Native 3D work: Blender or Godot ship their own UI

assessment.rationale: Actively maintained, but it is an immediate-mode native C++ GUI for tool panels with no scripting or CLI an agent can drive and no media output. Parameter control is better served by Leva or Theatre.js.
